name: Rope Sentry
shortDescription: A thief posted to keep the cut painter cut.
lookDescription: A badger in a river coat stands on the rope-island with a cut line in one paw.
examineDescription: The Rope Sentry was posted so the landing knot would stay cut. Adult. Not a classmate. Solo work. The whistle on the heron post is what they did not want heard.
lockNarration: The cut rope tightens in a paw that is not yours.
victoryNarration: The Rope Sentry leaves the island to the ropes. The cut end stays in the mud.
